The scalar trial still has the old upper energy. Hence, for a known lower bound delta>=delta0>0, [delta0*L,U] encloses the full conductance if[L,U] is the old finite-Jensen enclosure. The global process can be received for this fixture: with V=1+x^T D^-1 x, x.grad F=(8y^4-12y^2+8)U>=0, so LV<=2dim/beta; finite Gibbs mass and constant matched drift/noise retain the same measure. This is an elementary coordinator inference from the reviewed proofs, not a new Dots-audited theorem or general calibration result. Reading the authoritative family certificate's exact rational width and using delta0=997/1000 gives width1.0097590572291752<1.01, checked with Fraction arithmetic. Thus exact zero cross covariance is stronger than this observable needs. Acquiring a trustworthy bound on delta is still a real scientific task; it is not supplied by knowing the potential, and small delta alone need not force actual capacity collapse. This inference does not combine with the separate nonreversible stirring theorem automatically.
